_doc: R03 gameplay layer over data/world_layout.json. Points are [x, z] (+x east, -z north). Ids are stable and saved: never rename one. Antigravity: move a pos when you move the place; add entries for new places. Codex: everything here is activated by distance from ExplorationDirector.focus().

East: over the bridge to Northmere.
The King's Way: the Great Gate.
None pass without the royal seal.
Ashford. Mind the geese.

interactions.title: A soldiers' cairn
lines: Each stone was laid by someone who came home.

interactions.title: A boundary stone
lines: The crest has been chiselled away. Only the words 'HELD FOR ALL' remain.

interactions.title: A chapel marker
lines: Names of villagers, the last ones unweathered.

interactions.title: A cold camp
lines: Ash still dry. Black cloth snagged on a branch.

interactions.title: From Sentinel Crag
lines: Moonmere below, the capital to the south, snow-dark peaks behind.

interactions.title: From Watcher's Hill
lines: The Great Wall runs north until the haze takes it.

villagers.name: Old Bess
lines: The geese have more sense than the tax man.
Safe road, Commander.

lines: Is that your real horse?

lines: River's high. Use the bridge, not the ford.

lines: I saw riders in black near the old chapel.
